add.name: herdr
add.purpose: Controls Herdr, a terminal multiplexer built for coding agents: inspect and drive panes, tabs, workspaces, commands and other agents running inside them.
add.how_to_use: Use when explicitly working with Herdr (requires the herdr CLI and HERDR_ENV=1); lets one agent supervise or hand work to other agents in panes.
add.evidence: skills.sh 60k installs; repo 42k stars since Mar 2026 (fast-rising); listed on mcpservers.org
add.notes: Only useful if you run Herdr.

add.name: google-agents-cli-adk-code
add.purpose: Guides writing agent code with Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK): defining agents, tools, callbacks and state management, with API references.
add.how_to_use: Triggers on 'build an agent with ADK', 'add a tool', 'create a callback'; pairs with the existing agents-cli workflow/deploy skills. Needs Python ADK / agents-cli.
add.evidence: Official Google; skills.sh 470k installs (highest of the agents-cli set); mcpservers.org listed

add.name: google-agents-cli-eval
add.purpose: Detailed evaluation workflow for ADK agents: writing eval datasets, running evals, analyzing failures, comparing runs and optimizing the agent.
add.how_to_use: Triggers on 'evaluate my agent', 'write an eval dataset', 'analyze eval failures'. Needs agents-cli / ADK project.
add.evidence: Official Google; skills.sh 469k installs; 391-line SKILL.md plus references
add.notes: Complements muratcankoylan 'evaluation' (generic) with a concrete toolchain.
